trap.label: voz passiva
trap.wrong: A review expects in two years.
trap.right: A review is expected in two years.
trap.why: Português usa “espera-se”, voz reflexiva; inglês usa passiva com be.

mcq.q: Which sentence reports an expectation impersonally?

fix.wrong: A review expects in two years.
fix.right: A review is expected in two years.

fix.wrong: Supporters argued to the plan works.
fix.right: Supporters argued that the plan works.

rewrite.prompt: Passiva: “They expect a review in two years.”
rewrite.answer: A review is expected in two years.
